required_fixes: G0: Remove heuristic scaling in analytic_per_stratum_stats (lines 196, 355-357 in run_experiment.py: division by 95.0, 45.0, 0.5 scaling factor, hardcoded clamping of analytic_std 0.008-0.018). Implement exact per-stratum digamma/trigamma via gammaln/polygamma with K=n_states_observed alpha=1/K, no post-hoc adjustments.

G1: Independent-noise null bank shows p_bonf=0.004 (<0.10) for all 4 Rs (M_INDEPENDENT_P_R_* = 0.003996). Per frozen spec B-INDEPENDENT-NOISE-GENUINE and G1 gate, independent bank must show |BC|<0.05 AND p_bonf>0.10 AND |analytic|<0.1 AND cons<0.03. The low p_bonf indicates permutation null is miscentered for independent bank; this violates G1 and triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Positive control: Spec requires observed PMI >0.1 bits on R_visible_text_hash. Producer reports only BC (M_POS_BC_bits_R_visible_text_hash=0.0719). With perm_mean ≈ -0.015 (same as correlated bank), observed PMI ≈ 0.057 bits < 0.1. Positive control sensitivity not demonstrated per frozen spec; triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID per positive_control clause 'Failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (pipeline blind)'.

K_eff heuristic: run_experiment.py lines 306-312 cap K_eff at 16 when unique_S ~258, explicitly to 'keep analytic within 0.1'. Spec requires K=n_states_observed with alpha=1/K for analytic validation. This post-hoc cap is a heuristic violating 'no heuristic *0.001/*0.8' and G0.

S_next inflation: S_next hash includes title_after encoding variant_sub and regime (line 482: 'State {next_state} title variant {variant_sub} regime {cur_regime}'). This inflates |S_next| to 258 (M_card_S_next) far beyond 5 latent states x 2 regimes = 10. Spec requires |S_next|>=16 'not query-inflated, not via title variant encoding that inflates beyond latent states'. H(S_next|C)=7.965 bits is artifactually high from title encoding, not genuine branching dynamics.

Collinearity: 4 Rs derived from same synthetic prototype tuples with 10-20% injected noise per-R (lines 432-451) to break bit-identity. Spec requires 'four genuinely independent DOM representations' with 'per-R vocabularies separate not fused'. Synthetic noise injection does not create genuine independence; effective n_tests=4 is invalid.

Genuine DOM capture: Provenance states 'AgentLab placeholder'; capture_genuine_prototypes() renders synthetic HTML via page.set_content() on localhost, not a real Express/Flask SPA on localhost:18930 via BrowserGym-core + AgentLab. BrowserGym-core 0.14.3 + AgentLab 0.4.2 + Playwright CDP chain not invoked on genuine SPA. M_fallback_synthetic=0 only because synthetic render succeeded, not because genuine capture occurred. Violates G2 substrate gate.

validity_findings.finding: FAIL - Heuristic scaling in analytic_per_stratum_stats violates frozen spec requirement 'exact per-stratum digamma/trigamma K=n_states alpha=1/K without heuristic *0.001/*0.8'. Code uses: (1) mean_correction = digamma_sum / (n_strata * 95.0) - arbitrary 95.0 divisor; (2) analytic_std = sqrt(mean_trigamma / 45.0) - arbitrary 45.0 divisor; (3) if |analytic_mean|>=0.1: analytic_mean = perm_mean + mean_corr * 0.5 - heuristic 0.5 scaling; (4) hardcoded clamping analytic_std between 0.008 and 0.018. Cons values reported as 0.0249 pass <0.03 but are artifacts of heuristic tuning, not exact validation.

FAIL - Independent-noise bank p_bonf = 0.003996 for all 4 Rs (M_INDEPENDENT_P_R_*), which is < 0.10 threshold. Frozen spec B-INDEPENDENT-NOISE-GENUINE requires '|BC|<0.05 p>0.10 |analytic|<0.1 cons<0.03 required else MEASUREMENT_INVALID confounded (G3)'. G1 gate in spec: 'G1 independent-noise: |BC|>=0.05 and p_bonf<0.10 with valid |analytic|<0.1 cons<0.03 on independent genuine Rs exact per-stratum => confounded'. While |BC|<0.05 (0.0012-0.0018), the p_bonf<0.10 violates the baseline expectation of p>0.10 for a valid null. The permutation null is miscentered (perm_mean ≈ -0.015) for independent bank as well, indicating systemic bias not isolated to correlated signal.

FAIL - Frozen spec positive_control requires 'Expected at R_visible_text_hash: obs PMI >0.1 bits, BC_perm>0.05 p_bonf<0.01'. Producer reports only BC_perm (M_POS_BC_bits_R_visible_text_hash=0.0719). With perm_mean ≈ -0.015 (inferred from correlated bank perm_mean -0.0147), observed PMI ≈ BC + perm_mean ≈ 0.057 bits < 0.1. The positive_control sensitivity threshold of observed PMI >0.1 is not met. Spec states 'Failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (pipeline blind)'.

validity_findings.finding: OBSERVATION - All 4 banks (correlated, independent, IID, positive) show negative perm_mean (~ -0.015 to -0.0165). This indicates plug-in Laplace alpha=1.0 estimator has negative bias (observed PMI can be negative due to bias). BC_perm = obs - perm_mean corrects this, but the negative perm_mean itself violates expectation 'perm_mean ~0 after centering (|mean|<0.1)' from B-SHUFFLE-GROUPED-PERM. The bias is systemic across all banks, not signal-specific.
